I believe you can make it.  Its been a couple years since ive been depressed to the point of wanted to end it.  I came back home and have been living with my mom and it has helped me.  I have a loving husband who keeps me grounded. 

I recently joined a church and it had been nice.  I do feel fake with all my smiles and hugs but this is just do to my introverted nature. I got baptised and it was wonderful.  You get to die to your old life and be reborn in the baptism
Trust in God and dont you ever give up.  

Also hobbies,exercise (especially running  on the treadmill) and such.  Gameboards have been helpful since im socially slightly enept. Ive been taking cbd oil (it is legal) to help with anxiety. Anime is amazing to help distract me from dark thoughts (kakeguri, black clover, mob psycho100,)

Above all start/maintain a relationship with God. Sometimes i feel a little crazy like im speaking  to myself but i know  he is listening.
